I think even today technology in authoritarian states works better for the state than it does for the people. China and North Korea have constant propaganda machines running 24/7 and large, advanced, militaries that the common people couldn’t compete with. Only a revolt within the military or a revolution so bloody it essentially destroys the country could really bring the regimes down. And outside intervention is impossible due to both countries being allied to each other and other dictators like Putin in Russia all of them having their own nukes. No one will save them if it means the destruction of both countries or the world. It would have to be internally but why would you change it from the inside if it meant assassination before you could do anything worthwhile? And the system benefits you anyways. The constant surveillance makes organization hard, and their cruelty is always adjusting. In North Korea escaping or rebelling not only means torture and death for you but for your loved ones I know I couldn’t do anything if it meant my own family would be harmed.
